title: Manage physical sheet instance records
description: Create, rename, annotate, and delete a local SheetInstance record representing one user-identified physical label sheet without generalizing it to other stock.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can create a uniquely identified named sheet instance and optionally store notes
Rename and note updates preserve stable instance identity and timestamps
Deletion follows repository dependency policy and never changes another instance
Records survive reload and UI language says recorded instance rather than recognized or verified sheet

steps.details: Add a versioned SheetInstance shell with stable ID, name, notes, timestamps, and explicit user-identification semantics.
Add create, read, rename, note-update, and dependency-aware delete operations with atomic IndexedDB writes.
Add semantic labeled controls for lifecycle actions, confirmation for deletion, announced results, and focus restoration.
Test multiple instances, restart, rename/notes, delete cancellation/completion, keyboard operation, and absence of recognition claims.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse existing record lifecycle and dependency-aware deletion patterns.
The application stores the user's identity for one sheet; it cannot recognize or inspect physical stock.
Exact layout binding and used positions are added in TASK-77.
